title: Composition of pro-etale module inverse images with canonical constant coefficients
statement:
Let $g:Z\to X$ and $f:X\to Y$ be morphisms of schemes [def-pc-scheme], and let $\Lambda$ be a finite commutative ring. Use the small pro-etale sites and universe conventions of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], with constant ring sheaves $\Lambda_T$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf] and their module categories [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. For $h=f,g,f\circ g$ let $h^*$ and $h_*$ be the module inverse image and direct image of [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image], using precisely its canonical constant-section map $c^h_\Lambda$. There is a natural isomorphism of functors
$$(f\circ g)^*\xrightarrow{\sim}g^*f^*:\operatorname{Mod}(\Lambda_Y)\longrightarrow\operatorname{Mod}(\Lambda_Z).$$
It is the canonical comparison of left adjoints to the direct-image identification $(f\circ g)_*\cong f_*g_*$ induced on each object $V\to Y$ by $Z\times_X(X\times_YV)\cong Z\times_YV$, with the module actions given by the specified constant-section maps.
